parsed.rationale: All three types — `MaterialBlendMode`, `PlaybackBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — live in the same `Wallpaper` package and each independently defines an identical `displayName` computed property at line 41 of their respective files. Introducing a `BlendModeDisplayable` protocol with a default `displayName` implementation in a protocol extension (e.g., in a new `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/BlendModeDisplayable.swift`) eliminates all three duplicate bodies. Because the three types are enum-like blend modes sharing the same structural shape, a protocol with a default implementation is the most idiomatic Swift solution; no associated type is needed since `displayName` is a plain `String` property.
